title: Quantification of the Flavor Diagonal Hadronic CP Violation
summary: The flavor diagonal CP violation of elementary particle physics contributes to the atomic, nuclear, and nucleon electric dipole moments (EDMs), T-violating neutron optics, and to the angular correlations of beta decay. In this contribution, we review the basics and the importance of CP violation in the search for new physics beyond the standard model, the recent progress in the quantification of the hadron level CP violation contributing to the aforementioned observables, and finally the current attempt to solve the strong CP problem without additional interactions and fields.
